description: SereneDB test-config for duckdb_iceberg's own tests outside the catalog directories. Every entry is a known reason the test cannot run here -- see tests/duckdb/README.md.

skip_tests.reason: Reads data/iceberg/generated_0_01 and its expected_results, which nothing in the extension generates any more: upstream's scripts/upload_iceberg_to_s3_test_server.sh syncs a data/generated/iceberg/generated_0_01 that no generator writes (its own FIXME says so), and upstream CI never sets S3_TEST_SERVER_AVAILABLE for this extension.
